name: job-finder-ats
description: Aggregates ATS company slugs from public datasets, sweeps the ATS job APIs, normalizes the results, and filters them against a portable profile.

scripts.verify: node src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=ashby --only-unknown && node src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=greenhouse --only-unknown && node src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=lever --only-unknown
scripts.verify:all: node src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=ashby && node src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=greenhouse && node src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=lever
scripts.sweep: npm run sweep:ashby && npm run sweep:greenhouse && npm run sweep:lever
scripts.test: node src/derive-test.mjs && node src/filter-test.mjs && node src/adapters-test.mjs && node src/users-test.mjs && node src/interpret-test.mjs
scripts.refresh: npm run sync && npm run verify && npm run sweep && npm run derive
